notes.title: UPDATE 2 - LEVEL BADGES
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/E0utL7K.gif[/IMG]

This new FREE DLC update adds multiple level badges into the game, there are 3 badges per level and will be attained by completing various challenges within in each level. There is a total of 87 badges to acquire for the main campaign.

Enjoy!!!

notes.title: UPDATE 1 - Cheat Console
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/0YLOE4c.gif[/IMG]

We have added a cheat console and a bunch of cheats into the game for players to mess around with.

Whilst in a level press SHIFT+K to access the cheat console, type the code and hit enter.

You can find a full list of the current cheats available on our website http://decayinglogic.com/culling-of-the-cows-cheat-codes/

We'll be adding more cheats with future updates. 

Enjoy!!!
